description: This file is a shell script used to automate device reboot procedures, including handling maintenance windows, RFC processing, randomized reboot timing, and reboot notifications.

methods.name: calcRandTime
methods.description: Calculates a random time within a specified window for scheduled reboot, incorporating current time and window boundaries.

methods.name: checkMaintenanceWindow
methods.description: Checks whether the current time falls within the configured maintenance window for auto reboot.

methods.name: checkrfcstatus
methods.description: Checks if RFC processing is ongoing or completed and waits for RFC tasks to finish.
